_status: Space types, doors, hazards, and gainable map tokens from the Core Rules. Actual board geometry (spaces, adjacency, zones, obstacles) must come from board data files.

start.note: Counts as a General space. Investigators begin here in any order.

general.note: Valid target for Hidden Evidence / POI / Altar placement.

interaction.representation: non-gray circle with an icon (Light Switch, Computer, Ticket Booth, Medical Item, Door, Game Booth, etc.)

water.representation: double-blue wavy Movement Lines (Amusement Park: Tunnel of Love)

carriage.representation: Ferris Wheel / Zipper carriage spaces (Amusement Park)

standard.note: Walls typically only have the gray outline on the outside but still block line of sight from any direction.

movementOnly.note: Denoted between spaces that would otherwise be adjacent.

open.note: Door space with no token on it.

locked.note: No figure may move onto or through it. If a Locked Door is placed on the Adversary's space, the Adversary is Revealed and must Move to an adjacent space of their choice.

destroyed.note: Can be moved onto/through by any figure; can never be Locked again.

investigatorInteracts.lockDoor: Place a Locked Door token on an ADJACENT empty Door space.
investigatorInteracts.openDoor: Remove a Locked Door token from an adjacent space; OR remove a Damaged Door token from an adjacent space and replace it with a Destroyed Door token.

doors.adversaryBreakDoor: When adjacent to an empty Open Door space or a Locked Door token, place a Damaged Door token on it. If it already has a Damaged Door token, replace it with a Destroyed Door token. (Adversary-specific variations exist, e.g. The Horror breaks any Door within 3 spaces.)
doors.securityBar: A Door with a Security Bar can be Opened as usual; the Security Bar token is discarded.

windows.representation: light blue lines with a blood drop

investigatorMovesThrough.stopMovingForRestOfTurn: May lose 1 Stamina instead of gaining the Wound.

windows.adversaryMovesThrough: Spend 1 extra MP and place a Noise token on that Window (direction not indicated; max 1 Noise token per Window per round).

lightSwitches.interact: Place a Bright token on the connected Zone; all spaces in that Zone become Bright for the remainder of the round.
lightSwitches.afterRound: Flip the Bright token to its Faltering Lights side; that Zone's lights can never be turned on again.

bright.effect: All spaces in the Zone are Bright.
bright.burnsOut: Typically flipped to Faltering Lights after the current round ends.

falteringLights.effect: Bright tokens cannot be placed on this Zone. No other effect.

dim.placement: Zone you are in or adjacent to
dim.effect: All spaces in the Zone are Dim; typically remains for the rest of the game. Bright overrides Dim.

openWindow.effect: No longer a Map Hazard; all players (including the Adversary) move through with no penalty and no Noise.

secretPassage.placement: any adjacent space, connecting to any other space of your choice
secretPassage.effect: Those spaces now count as adjacent and can be moved through by all players. Does not change line of sight or light levels.

falseDoor.effect: Counts as an Obstacle (blocks line of sight); no figure can move through it.

falseWindow.effect: Counts as an Obstacle (blocks line of sight); no figure can move through it; no Trading through it.

medicalItemSpaces.note: Medical Item tokens placed here at setup based on Investigator count; pick up with an Interact Action.
